claims.text: The hotel is at 905 Country Club Road in Ojai, California.

findings.quote: 905 Country Club Rd., Ojai, California 93023

claims.text: The resort spans 220 acres, with organic herb gardens growing 65 culinary and medicinal herbs.

findings.quote: Our treasured 220 acres are home to organic herb gardens that showcase 65 diverse culinary and medicinal herbs.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler describes a sprawling Spanish revival hotel with towering oak trees and running fountains.

findings.quote: Time seems to slow down as you pull up to this sprawling Spanish revival hotel. Birds chirp from atop the towering oak trees, and the peacefully running fountains set the tone

claims.text: The Wallace Neff Estate Rooms are named for the original guestroom building created by architect Wallace Neff.

findings.quote: Named in honor of the original guestroom building created by famed architect Wallace Neff

claims.text: Fireside Terrace Rooms have a terrace with seating around a private gas-burning stone fire pit.

findings.quote: Each guestroom features a spacious terrace with intimate seating around the warmth of your own private gas-burning stone fire pit.

claims.text: The Moonrise Penthouse, atop Spa Ojai, has an outdoor terrace with views of the Topatopa Mountains.

findings.quote: Secluded atop Spa Ojai, the Moonrise Penthouse
also features an expansive outdoor terrace with sublime views of the Topatopa Mountains

claims.text: The Paseo Villas sit beside the Spa Village and are surrounded by a rose garden courtyard.

findings.quote: Nestled aside the Spa Village, our private Paseo Villas are surrounded by a lush rose garden courtyard.

claims.text: The Tranquility Pool and Energy Pool are located at Spa Ojai.

findings.quote: visit our Tranquility Pool & Energy Pool located at Spa Ojai.

claims.text: Guided horseback rides through the valley take in views of the Topatopa mountain range.

findings.quote: Join our expert guides for a relaxing, hour-long ride through the valley, while you take in breathtaking views of the Topatopa mountain range.

claims.text: Complimentary daily fitness and wellness classes include yoga, meditation and spinning.

findings.quote: Enjoy a variety of complimentary fitness and wellness classes presented by our highly qualified team of instructors. Daily classes include Fitness Walks, Yoga, Meditation, Spinning, TRX, and Body Conditioning.

claims.text: Camp Oak offers daily theme-based programming for children ages 4 to 12.

findings.quote: Bring your little ones (ages 4 to 12) to Camp Oak for daily theme-based programming

claims.text: Hands-on cooking classes are held at The Farmhouse using locally grown ingredients.

findings.quote: lead hands-on cooking classes at The Farmhouse. Explore locally grown and regionally raised ingredients

claims.text: Filmmaker Frank Capra used Ojai to represent Shangri-La in his film Lost Horizon.

findings.quote: Legendary filmmaker Frank Capra found the valley so beautiful he used Ojai to represent Shangri-La in his film, Lost Horizon.

claims.text: Spa Ojai is a 30,000-square-foot spa focused on natural and organic beauty and wellness practices.

findings.quote: Our 30,000-square-foot Spa Ojai embraces natural and organic beauty and wellness practices.

claims.text: Pools include the family-friendly Pixie Pool with pool games and the Indigo Pool & Bar, reserved for adults.

findings.quote: family-friendly Pixie Pool full of excitement and pool games, to our exclusive adult's only Indigo Pool & Bar

claims.text: A resident beekeeper leads visits inside a working hive, ending with a tasting of cold-pressed raw honey.

findings.quote: with our resident beekeeper as you hear about the honey-making process, see inside a working hive, spot the queen bee, and savor a tasting of delicious, cold-pressed raw honey.
The excursion will conclude with a honey tasting of cold-pressed, raw honey

claims.text: The resort's 18-hole golf course plays 6,292 yards at par 70.

findings.quote: This 18-hole golf course plays 6,292 yards with a par 70

claims.text: Wallace Neff Estate Rooms do not have bathtubs.

findings.quote: Wallace Neff Estate Rooms do not feature bathtubs.

claims.text: Penthouses are for guests without pets; pets are welcome in a variety of other room categories.

findings.quote: Penthouses are reserved for guests traveling without pets. We welcome pets in a variety of other room categories at the Inn.
